reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune. Imported from CCEH tune 000246 (the melody read from 000246a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells James Walch as “James Walsh”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. James Walch's dates (1837–1901) are from https://hymnary.org/tune/eagley_walch (James Walch, b. near Bolton 1837, d. Llandudno Junction, August 1901; EAGLEY and TIDINGS, 1875; CCEH spells him Walsh); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000246a.nwc).
